substitution_contract.description: Templates are raw payload bytes with plain-text placeholders; the rig substitutes per run before feeding stdin. Unconsumed identity fields stay as permanent placeholders (hygiene law).

placeholders.{SESSION_ID}: the harness session id (rig-generated stable per simulated session)
placeholders.{SIM_ROOT}: the scratch governed root, forward-slash drive form (D:/...); replaces the captured governed-checkout path
placeholders.{SIM_ROOT_BSLASH}: same root, backslash form (Windows alias fixture form)
placeholders.{OUTSIDE_ROOT}: the scratch outside-target root, forward-slash drive form; replaces the captured outside-repository path
placeholders.{WORKSPACE_ROOT}: permanent placeholder for the owner workspace root (unconsumed field, hygiene law)
placeholders.{WORKSPACE_ROOT_POSIX}: permanent placeholder, POSIX form (unconsumed; bash command bodies use {SIM_ROOT} forms instead so the detector sees the scratch root)
placeholders.{TRANSCRIPT}: permanent placeholder for the owner temp transcript path (unconsumed)
placeholders.{MODEL}: permanent placeholder for the serving model string (unconsumed)
